page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge is a general-purpose server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 12 dedicated vCPUs derived from 6 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It is equipped with 48.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core CPU performance and single-threaded compression tasks, such as gzip and bzip3, fall into the weak and poor categories, representing the bottom 10% to 25% of tested hardware. Conversely, multi-core performance scales effectively, with stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores all registering in the average tier. Memory bandwidth and Redis SET operations also perform at average levels, while static web serving throughput is weak.

The ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge is qualitatively positioned as a stable, resource-dedicated option for workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. Because single-core performance is limited, this instance is best suited for multi-threaded applications, database operations, and general-purpose backend services that can distribute processing across its 12 dedicated vCPUs.
